title: Observability: add context-grokker service and tiered noise-gating for alerts
author: Priya Shah
body:
Motivation: Production SLO noise from long-running multi-turn chat and high-entropy embeddings has been driving alert churn for several tenants. We need a higher-fidelity signal that explains whether a cost/latency spike is meaningful or just context-driven noise. This PR introduces a lightweight observability component named 'context-grokker' that synthesizes per-invocation contextual anchors (prompt shape, token-phase profile, kv-cache hit heuristic, tenant burstiness score, embed-similarity bucket) and attaches a stable anchor id to spans and metrics so downstream alerting can make smarter decisions.

Summary of changes: Implement context-grokker service that ingests invocation metadata and emits context.anchor tags; add proto metric definitions for anchor-backed rollups; enrich traces with anchor IDs; add a tiered noise-gating alert adapter that dynamically widens alert thresholds when anchors indicate known noisy patterns; ship console panels and a feature flag; add integration tests and a short runbook for operators.

Key behavioral notes (what this does at runtime): The grokker computes an invocation-context score (0..1) and a discrete set of tags (prompt_shard, phase_profile, kv_warm, embed_cohort). The score aggregation is cheap (microsecond-level shim) and emitted as anchor.score metric. Alerts wired through the noise-gate adapter consult the anchor tags over a 5m sliding window: low score -> strict alerts, mid score -> dampened alerts (15-40% threshold widen depending on historical volatility), high score + known noisy cohort -> suppress duplicate alerts and surface a single summary. There is a hard fallback that never suppresses severity=P1.

Commits (high level): - Add context-grokker core and API (service.go, README) - Add anchor proto and metric names (anchor.proto) - Trace enricher: attach anchor_id to span tags (anchor_linker.go) - Noise-gate adapter and alert tiering logic (noise_gate.go) - Console: dashboard + feature flag opt-in (context-grokker-overview.json, observability_flags.go) - Tests: integration harness and lightweight unit tests (context_grokker_test.go) - Docs: ops runbook and tuning guidelines (observability-noise-gating.md)

Files changed (high-level diff): - observability/grokker/service.go: New service and batching ingestion; core scoring function, 320 lines added. - telemetry/metrics/anchor.proto: new metric /tag definitions for anchor.score, anchor.cohort. - tracing/span_enricher/anchor_linker.go: span enrichment hook to attach anchor_id and anchor.score to existing spans. - alerts/noise_gate/noise_gate.go: alert adapter that consults recent anchors and applies tiered thresholding and dedup rules. - console/dashboards/context-grokker-overview.json: New dashboard with anchor cohort explorer, noise-decay meter, sample trace overlay. - integration-tests/observability/context_grokker_test.go: end-to-end checks including collision detection and alert-flow. - docs/ops/observability-noise-gating.md: operator runbook and rollout checklist.

Review conversation (summary): Zoe: "Please add a unit test for anchor ID collisions and clarify lifetime semantics of anchor IDs for multi-stage invocations." -> Priya: "Added collision test and documented anchor TTL (10m by default, configurable via feature flag)." Liam: "Noise gate looks good but quantify how we pick widen factors per tenant." -> Priya: "Added tenant volatility estimator and defaults in the runbook; the console panel surfaces the recommended multiplier for each tenant so SREs can tune per-account." Andre: "Add a safety valve to always emit the raw token-cost metric (so we can audit suppression)." -> Priya: "Noise-gate preserves raw metrics in a hidden namespace (raw.*) and adds a suppression_reason tag; updated tests."

CI and rollout notes: First CI run failed due to flaky integration test (timing-sensitive assert in context_grokker_test); I adjusted the test to use eventual consistency with a 15s retry window and reran. Subsequent CI passed (unit/integration/lint). Feature flag default is OFF; rollout plan is staged opt-in: enable for internal tenants first, then opt-in for a cohort of external tenants using feature flag gating. Metrics names are namespaced under observability.anchor.* to avoid collision.

Operational impact and telemetry: New high-cardinality tags are limited to a small enumerated set (cohort buckets, prompt_shard) to avoid explosion; anchor_id is stable but ephemeral (TTL) and stored only on sampled traces and rollups; core metrics exposed: observability.anchor.score, observability.anchor.cohort, observability.anchor.ttl, observability.anchor.suppression_rate. We also added a dashboard and a short playbook for tuning the tiered wideners.

Rollback plan: Flip feature flag off, which immediately disables enrichment and returns all alerts to the existing static thresholds; docs include a quick remediation section for mis-suppressed P2/P3 alerts.

Release notes: Adds an optional observability component (context-grokker) that improves alert quality by tagging invocations with contextual anchors and enabling tiered noise-gating. Opt-in behind feature flag; no customer-facing API changes.

Merge: Squash merged after approvals from reviewers; all CI green.
